shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && echo '--- tsconfig ---' && cat tsconfig.json && echo '--- vite ---' && cat vite.config.ts && echo '--- index.html ---' && cat index.html && echo '--- main.tsx ---' && cat src/main.tsx && echo '--- App.tsx ---' && cat src/App.tsx && echo '--- vite-env ---' && cat src/vite-env.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/types.d.ts && echo '--- addLanguage ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addLanguageKeysets.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addLanguageKeysets.js && echo '--- addComponent ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addComponentKeysets.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/addComponentKeysets.js && echo '--- i18n ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.js"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure* 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- useLang ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- package exports ---'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types,exports:p.exports},null,2))\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo '--- SegmentedRadioGroup dts ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo '--- Select dts ---'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js; echo '--- useLang js ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.js; echo '--- useTheme js ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.js"

/bin/bash -lc 'for d in Select Pagination Dialog Alert Toaster; do echo "=== $d ==="; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/$d/i18n -type f 2>/dev/null | head; done; echo '"'--- Select en ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/en.json 2>/dev/null; echo '--- Select ru ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/use-sync-external-store/shim/index.js 2>/dev/null; echo '--- with-selector ---'; cat node_modules/use-sync-external-store/shim/with-selector.js 2>/dev/null; echo '--- cjs shim ---'; cat node_modules/use-sync-external-store/cjs/use-sync-external-store-shim.production.min.js 2>/dev/null | head -c 2000"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const p='node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.development.js';const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const i=s.indexOf('function subscribeToStore'); console.log(s.slice(i, i+1200));\""

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.development.js','utf8');let idx=0;while(true){const i=s.indexOf('useSyncExternalStore', idx); if(i<0) break; console.log('---', i); console.log(s.slice(Math.max(0,i-300), i+1500)); idx=i+1;}\" | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json; echo '--- ru ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json; echo '--- Alert en ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/en.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/ru.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && echo '--- diff ---' && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/i18n.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });\" && git status --short"
